newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine c. bank sells dlrs at 29 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine c. bank sells dlrs at 29 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine central bank intervened in the market early on Wednesday to sell dollars at 29 pesos, traders said.
The central bank was selling small amounts of dollars at $500,000 each.
After 30 minutes of trading, volume had reached $12.5 million.
Despite the limited amount, the early presence of the central bank would help calm the market, traders said.
The central bank earlier said its limited intervention was meant to provide direction after it announced on Friday it would loosen its grip on the peso.
"Essentially, it is to provide direction to the market, some indicative guidance," central bank managing director Amando Tetangco told reporters late on Tuesday.
